author: Fextralife
description:
Valor Mortis Beginner Guide - 10 Things The Game Doesn't Tell You
In this video, I'm going to be talking about Valor Mortis and more specifically things the game, doesn't tell you. That can make your playthrough a little bit easier and even a little bit more rewarding if you knew these things from the beginning of the game. Now, I mean, this is not a completely hard game in my opinion, although it does have some difficulty spikes.
